At line 13: `File file = new File(outputDir, name);`
This line creates a new File object using the `name` variable that was computed at line 11.

At line 24: `FileUtils.forceMkdir(file);`
This line uses the `file` variable, which was created at line 13 using the `name` variable.

The dependency chain is: `name` (line 11) → `file` (line 13) → `file` (line 24). Since `file` is constructed using `name` at line 13, and line 24 uses that same `file` variable, the value of `file` used at line 24 does depend on the value of `name` computed at line 11.
